revision_summary: Three quote timestamps in script_coverage are off and must be corrected: (1) the bill_amount customer quote 'It says it's two thousand three sixty' is at 03:50, not 01:56; (2) the bill_collection customer_quote 'You sent three pictures. Right? Yeah.' is at 04:45/04:48, not 02:01; (3) the appointment_set customer_quote 'Yeah. That'd be good.' is at 06:32, not 05:59. These are the same rep/customer lines, just mis-timestamped -- easy fix, low severity, but must be corrected for accuracy. Additionally: (a) reframe the '90 seconds of dead air' language in state_changes and coaching_focus -- the transcript shows the rep actively (if inefficiently) engaged throughout 03:26-04:20, so 'dead air' overstates rep passivity; use 'slow, repetitive guidance without pivoting to verbal read-back' instead. (b) Fix the schema reference in cherry_pick_moments[3]: shopping_customer_protocol is for mobile/away-from-home customers (e.g. at Walmart), not a fitting citation for this at-home portal-navigation friction -- cite elderly_low_tech_protocol's verbal-readback principle instead, or note it as a general alternative-path gap without over-specifying a mismatched named protocol. (c) Add a cherry_pick_moments entry for the co-owner/spouse-inclusion gap: the husband is identified as co-owner at 00:44 but never invited onto the booked appointment, which is a direct protocols.spouse_decision / verify.title_co_owners miss the current draft only gestures at via a null field in observed_outcome and a soft mention in handoff_brief -- this deserves explicit surfacing given the schema's emphasis on this exact failure mode. (d) Soften the handoff_brief's framing of the territory/team mismatch as an 'unresolved concern' since it was fully resolved live on the call.
